symptom: A brand palette hand-edited into `theme/web/custom-variables.scss` works once, and then `mxcli theme apply` reports the file as `skipped` and refuses to touch it — the project has silently taken the theme out of mxcli's hands to change one colour
cause: The theme registry was embed-only: `List`/`Get` read `assetsFS` and nothing else, so there was nowhere to put a fourth theme and the generated block was the only place to put a palette
insight: **A digest fence that refuses an edit is a signal that the thing being edited should have been authorable.** Project-local themes live in `theme/mxcli-themes/` — committed (`.mxcli/` is gitignored by `mxcli init`) and not compiled (mxbuild's entry point is `theme/web/main.scss`; it does not glob `theme/`, verified against a real 11.13 build that nothing under it reaches `deployment/`). Scaffolding **must** rename the identifiers built from the theme name (`@mixin mxcli-<name>-<alt>`, the `@import`) — a plain copy collides the moment both themes exist. Verified end to end: seeded palette → `mxbuild --target=deploy` → measured `--brand-primary` in a real browser in both variants. Tests `cmd/mxcli/theme/create_test.go`, `cmd/mxcli/cmd_theme_test.go`
